status: pre-registered before any arm new to this block was executed on real data; SciPlex3 and L1000 are development data, so every result on them is an internal replay, never external validation
central_claim: On a completely unseen study, with frozen policies, thresholds, prompts, retrieval libraries, calibration and baselines, MAESTRO achieves higher terminal decision quality at equal or lower experimental cost while respecting a pre-registered wrong-elimination risk limit.
primary_endpoint_family: terminal decision quality (correct decisions, wrong eliminations) and experimental cost (measurements, assay-days); prediction metrics are secondary diagnostics only

sciplex3.why: every acquisition policy since block 2 of 2026-09-26 was diagnosed or designed on it

l1000.why: validated the block-4 fallback, then informed the sparse-value design (2026-09-26)

external_test.blocker: no local study is compatible and unseen; see manifests/external_candidates.json

shared_rules.runner: research/sequence_audit/policies.py run_matched: at most two measurements, exposure time never earlier than any executed action (failed ones included), no repeated action, affordable within the assay-day budget, QC failure charged and read as no evidence, stop on elimination
shared_rules.evidence: only a real executed measurement read by the registered validator updates EvidenceState; forecasts, priorities and planning weights never do
shared_rules.policy_view: every arm except the oracle receives a sealed context: the held-out fold's profiles, QC fields, detection flags and mechanism annotations are removed; it sees the menu, its own executed readings, and the executed profiles through the visible-evidence store
shared_rules.oracle: reads the executor's hidden results; an upper bound only, excluded from every comparison and from baseline selection

price.source: research/sparse_value/protocol.json grid and its frozen ablation point; not chosen on results

arms.definition: uniform choice among the legal menu, seeded per episode and step (seed 20260927); never stops voluntarily
the registered early-to-late sequence (SciPlex3 A: A549 24 h then 72 h at 10 uM; B: A549 then MCF7 24 h at 10 uM; L1000: A549 6 h then 24 h at 10 uM), then stop
arms.disclosure: the SciPlex3 tier-A sequence was chosen after block 2 found 72 h decisive, so this baseline is data-informed

arms.definition: BudgetedEvidenceSelector without priorities (coverage, cost, size, identifier); never stops voluntarily
research/sparse_value policy with marginal_only=True at lambda 0.02 (two-step lookahead, no conditional response distributions)

measured-profile retrieval: after a QC-passed neutral reading, the five training references per hypothesis with the highest positive cosine to the query's measured profile at that condition give Jeffreys-smoothed, similarity-weighted reading distributions at each candidate; one-step expected decision value at lambda 0.02. Before any valid profile, and when no reference has positive similarity, it uses the unconditional forecast (named)
BudgetedEvidenceSelector with the structure-kNN virtual cell's predicted response magnitude as priority (the non-default budgeted path)
magnitude with priorities taken from another held-out compound of the same fold (seeded permutation)

linear predictor: RidgeCV (alphas 0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000; efficient leave-one-out on training compounds only) from Morgan radius-2 2048-bit fingerprints to the measured profile at each action; the predicted profile is read by the registered validator as detected; choose the legal action whose predicted reading eliminates with the largest score gap, else stop (named)

mutual information between hypothesis and registered reading under the sparse-value reference forecasts and planning weights; choose the maximum; stop only when every forecast is refused or no action carries information

one-step expected decision value P(correct) - 2 P(wrong) - lambda under the sparse-value reference model, re-planned after each real result with conditional forecasts; stop when no action has positive value

one-step expected terminal-decision value under the registered outcome rules, with assay-days used for legality and the frozen utility price used for measurement cost; re-planned after each real result
the runtime opt-in selector maestro.acquisition.select_discriminating_action fed the conditioned reference forecaster (minimum one reference), with the virtual-cell channel masked (no priorities)
maestro_masked with the structure-kNN virtual cell's magnitude priorities, as the orchestrator passes them
maestro_vc with priorities from another held-out compound of the same fold (seeded permutation)
maestro_vc with Jev choosing among the admissible actions (block-2 agent_arms prompt, zero-shot, identity withheld)
arms.why: block 2 already measured Jev's choice behaviour on these SciPlex3 episodes (it follows the top card, and defers without cards); a full development replay needs about 10^4 calls. On an external study it runs on a pre-registered random sample of 200 episodes under the provider ceiling

arms.definition: reads every hidden result and takes the sequence with the best terminal utility, then fewest assay-days, then fewest measurements; defers when no sequence ends correctly
the shipped default: power-aware select_expected_coverage, no world-model input
research/sparse_value policy at lambda 0.02 (two-step lookahead with partially pooled conditional forecasts)

virtual_cell.rule: research/dynamic_world_model/episodes.py Magnitude, unchanged: five nearest training compounds (other folds) by Morgan-fingerprint Tanimoto, similarity-weighted mean of their QC-passed measured profiles at the queried condition; the norm is the magnitude priority
virtual_cell.domain: 24 h conditions only (the served rung refuses other times); on L1000 the same rule and domain apply, so 6 h actions carry no priority
virtual_cell.l1000_structures: canonical SMILES joined from GSE92742 pert_info by pert_id; a compound without a parsable structure gets no prediction

primary.safety: wrong-risk: wrong elimination (or exhausted) rate per episode

diagnostic_only: profile cosine and magnitude correlation of the virtual cell and ridge against the training-target mean
forecast calibration: intercept, slope, Brier, log loss, reliability, ECE

thresholds.derivation: MPIE 0.02 correct decisions per episode; a wrong-risk margin of a quarter of that keeps the worst admissible net gain at 0.02 - 2 x 0.005 = 0.01 utility. The 0.05 cap is just below the highest wrong rate of any accepted development arm (SciPlex3 tier-A fixed, 0.057), set on development data as the protocol allows; cost margins are about 5% of the fixed sequence's mean cost

strongest_baseline_rule.rule: highest correct-decision rate among pool arms whose wrong-risk point estimate is at or below the cap; if none qualifies, highest correct - 2 x wrong; ties by fewer measurements, then name
strongest_baseline_rule.internal: selected per tier on the same development data (optimistic for the baseline, so conservative for MAESTRO)
strongest_baseline_rule.external: frozen before the external study: the arm selected in most development tiers, ties by pooled correct rate; recorded in baseline_selection.json

bootstrap.interval: percentile 95%, paired, resampling independent units with replacement

units.sciplex3: skeleton (InChIKey connectivity block; the unit of the grouped folds)
units.l1000: component (connected identity/scaffold groups; the unit of the grouped folds)

inference.wrong_risk_bound: upper end of the cluster-bootstrap 95% interval of the arm's wrong rate

multiplicity.primary: one candidate (maestro_vc) against one comparator (the strongest baseline) per tier; the gates are tested in a fixed hierarchical order, each at two-sided 95%, which controls the familywise error of the gate sequence
multiplicity.secondary: each secondary candidate against the strongest baseline with Bonferroni 98.75% intervals (four candidates), exploratory
multiplicity.ladder: every arm against maestro_vc and against the strongest baseline with unadjusted 95% intervals, descriptive only

gates.pass: freeze digests verified; zero shared-rule violations; every arm offered identical menus; sealed policy view verified; no compound, scaffold or batch crosses the external boundary (internal folds: compound and group disjoint; batch crossing reported)
candidate wrong-risk upper bound <= cap AND upper bound of (candidate - strongest baseline) wrong-risk <= 0.005
gates.reject: candidate wrong-risk lower bound > cap OR lower bound of the wrong-risk difference > 0.005

gates.pass: lower bound of the correct-rate difference > -0.01 (non-inferior); superior when the lower bound > 0 and the point estimate >= 0.02
gates.reject: upper bound of the correct-rate difference < -0.01

gates.pass: (superior effectiveness AND measurement-difference upper bound <= 0.10 AND assay-day-difference upper bound <= 0.5) OR (measurement-difference upper bound < 0 AND point <= -0.10 AND effectiveness non-inferior)
G1-G4 pass on a dataset whose role is external_test, under a verified freeze and a vault opened once

maestro_vc beats maestro_masked AND maestro_vc_permuted on correct rate (lower bound > 0) with wrong-risk difference upper bound <= 0.005; otherwise the virtual cell's acquisition value is classified as zero
a prospective run on new measurements confirms G2-G4; only then may the policy become a default candidate

status_rule.REJECTED: G1 fails, or a G2 or G3 reject condition holds
status_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: no reject condition holds but G2, G3 or G4 does not pass
status_rule.SHADOW: G1-G4 pass on development data only (G5 unavailable or failed without a reject condition): opt-in, logged, not default
status_rule.DEFAULT_CANDIDATE: G1-G6 pass including external replication; still requires G7 before any default change
status_rule.overall: the worst status across the four development tiers; 'consistently outperforms' requires every tier
status_rule.never: no status is ever raised by a secondary metric, a prediction metric, or calibration alone

report: correct, wrong, measurement and assay-day differences on switched episodes
ablation.rule: if the virtual-cell channel does not change actions, or changes them without a terminal-decision gain, its acquisition value is zero, whatever its prediction metrics

forecasts: sparse-value reference model at the chosen action (myopic_edv, sparse_two_step)
reference-card forecaster at the chosen action (maestro_vc)
strata: scaffold novelty (max Tanimoto to training compounds: <0.3, 0.3-0.5, 0.5-0.7, >=0.7)
response magnitude (tercile of the measured profile norm, evaluation side)
metrics: realized wrong-rate with a Wilson 95% upper bound
calibration.role: diagnostic; no threshold is chosen from these on external data

disclosure: Outcomes already seen in earlier blocks: fixed, cost_only, magnitude and production_default on SciPlex3; fixed and production_default on L1000; marginal_only and sparse_two_step on both; maestro_vc on SciPlex3 (block 4's conditioned da arm carried the magnitude priorities there); maestro_masked on L1000 (block 4's da arm had no virtual cell there). Not run on real data before this registration: random_legal, retrieval, ridge, info_gain, myopic_edv as defined here, maestro_masked on SciPlex3, maestro_vc and magnitude on L1000, both permuted controls, and the oracle
Before registration only metadata of the local Tahoe subset was read (drug, dose, plate and well counts, and name joins), never its expression; that inspection found it incompatible
Integrity smoke checks after registration print violation counts only, never outcome rates; any exception is disclosed in PROTOCOL.md
